chunks: Whatever is in it from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, I have narrated from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah have mercy on him—from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl al-Daqqāq, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar al-Juʿfī al-Kūfī, and he was a mawlā.

key_terms.الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ عُمَرَ: A transmitter from whom reports in this section are narrated.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a direct statement of narration by the compiler.
key_terms.مَوْلًى: A freed servant or client affiliate.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a chain-identification statement that documents the route of transmission rather than presenting a substantive hadith matn.
